provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Small World rules (Days of Wonder, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Take the map for your player count; Game Turn marker on the first spot
Storage tray of Race tokens open beside the map
Shuffle the Race banners: 5 faceup in a column, the stack faceup below them
Shuffle the Special Power badges: one to the left of each banner, the stack beside the banner stack (6 combos visible)
A Lost Tribe token on every region with a Lost Tribe symbol; a Mountain token on every Mountain region
Each player takes five 1-value Victory coins; the rest form the stash
Players take turns clockwise; the first player advances the Game Turn marker each round
